q: A white billiard ball of mass 0.20 kg travelling horizontally at 3.0 m s⁻¹ hits a red billiard ball of the same mass which is at rest. After the collision the white ball continues in the same direction at 1.0 m s⁻¹. What is the speed of the red ball immediately after the collision?

A ball is dropped from a height of 16 m onto a horizontal surface and on each bounce loses 50% of its kinetic energy. After which bounce does the maximum height of the rebound first fall below 160 cm? (air resistance is negligible)
A tram travelling along a straight horizontal track at 12.0 m s⁻¹ brakes and decelerates to rest at a constant rate of 1.50 m s⁻². What distance does the tram travel while it is decelerating?

An object X of mass 2.0 kg is moving at 4.5 m s⁻¹ on a smooth horizontal surface. A 5.0 N force is applied to X in the direction of its motion for 3.0 s. It then collides head on with, and sticks to, a stationary object Y of mass 3.0 kg. What is the speed of X and Y as they move off together?

P and Q are two fixed points on the ocean surface 6.0 m apart, and a wave travels in the direction P to Q at constant speed with frequency 0.50 Hz. A wave peak passes Q at time t = 0 s, and the next peak travelling towards Q passes P at t = 0.80 s. What is the speed of the wave?

A tennis ball travelling at 24.0 m s⁻¹ is hit by a racket and returns along its original path, undergoing a change in velocity of 48.0 m s⁻¹. Its acceleration while in contact with the racket is constant with magnitude 6000 m s⁻². What total distance does the ball travel while in contact with the racket?

A uniform metre ruler of mass 100 g is 1.00 m long. A small object of mass 20 g is fixed at the 0 cm mark and another of mass 80 g at the 100 cm mark. When the ruler is balanced on a pivot, what distance is the pivot from the 0 cm mark?

A solid cylindrical metal bar of uniform cross-sectional area 12 cm² and volume 180 cm³ rests on a horizontal surface on one of its circular faces. The pressure on the surface due to the bar is 0.45 N cm⁻². What is the density of the metal? (gravitational field strength = 10 N kg⁻¹)

A transverse wave of amplitude 3.0 cm travels along a stretched string with frequency 12 Hz and wavelength 0.25 m. What is the average speed of a particle in the string as it oscillates over a time of 2.0 s?
The ratio Q : R is 5 : 2 and the ratio R : S is 3 : 10. Which of the following gives the ratio Q : S in its simplest form?
A nuclide of lead-214 changes by radioactive decay into the nuclide lead-210. Which combination of emissions produces this change?

A transverse wave travelling through a medium has a frequency of 5.0 Hz, a wavelength of 4.0 cm and an amplitude of 3.0 cm. What is the total distance travelled by a particle of the medium in one minute?
The total of three numbers p, q and r is 375. The ratio p : q is 5 : 7 and the ratio q : r is 4 : 11. What is the value of p + r?
A paint colour mixes red, blue and yellow paint. The ratio of red to blue is 18 : 5, the ratio of blue to yellow is p : 3, and the ratio of red to yellow is 12 : 5. What is the value of p?

A rocket travelling in space burns its fuel at a constant rate, and by expelling the burnt fuel through a nozzle the engine applies a constant force to the rocket. What is happening to the magnitude of the acceleration of the rocket?
options: It is increasing at an increasing rate.
It is increasing at a constant rate.
It is increasing at a decreasing rate.
It is decreasing at an increasing rate.
It is decreasing at a constant rate.
It is decreasing at a decreasing rate.

q: A circle has its centre at (0, 0). What is the equation of the tangent that touches the circle at the point (4, 3)?

The price of item P is reduced by 10%, and the next day the new price is increased by 10%. The price of item Q is increased by 10%, and the next day the new price is reduced by 10%. How does the final price of each item compare with its original price?
The curve y = x² − 4x + 5 meets the straight line y = 2x + c at two points with x-coordinates p and q, where q > p. Given that q − p = 8, what is the value of the constant c?

A non-ideal transformer has 100 turns on the primary coil and 25 turns on the secondary coil. It is supplied with 3.0 kW of electrical power at a current of 12.5 A. The output voltage is the same as for an ideal transformer, but the output current is 40 A. What is the efficiency of the transformer?

A beaker containing 180 g of water at 25 °C has a 20 g ice cube at 0 °C added to it, and no heat is transferred to the surroundings. What is the final temperature once all the ice has melted? (specific heat capacity of water = 4 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹; specific latent heat of fusion of water = 300 J g⁻¹)

A cyclist rides to the top of a hill, then immediately turns around and descends the same track to her starting point. She takes 40 minutes at an average speed of 12 km h⁻¹ to reach the top, and her average speed for the whole journey is 15 km h⁻¹. What is the average speed of her descent?
Consider the equation 2x² + 4x + c = 0, where c is a constant. The positive difference between the roots of this equation is √10. What is the value of c?
x, y and z are positive variables. y is inversely proportional to the square of x, and y = 20 when x = 3. z is directly proportional to x, and z = 1.2 when x = 6. What is z when y = 80?
